Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Greetings Meths, been a while!

My question is the following: Can you play Set's Curse on Ilomba? Allow me to highlight lines that makes me wonder.

> Name: Ilomba
> [EK:R]
> Cardtype: Retainer
> Animal with 1 life. Requires a Laibon.
> Put Ilomba on any minion (this is a +1 stealth  action if that minion is controlled by another Methuselah). If Ilomba would burn a life (or would otherwise be burned), this minion burns a blood or life instead. If he or she cannot, he or she is burned. A minion may have only one Ilomba.
> Artist: Ron Spencer
>
> Name: Set's Curse
> [LotN:R]
> Cardtype: Action
> Cost: 2 blood
> Discipline: Serpentis
> +1 stealth action.
> [ser]  Burn any ally or retainer to put this card into play. This card becomes an animal ally with 3 life, 2 strength and 0 bleed. This ally cannot have or use equipment or retainers and cannot play action cards.
> [SER] As above, but burn a vampire with capacity less than 3 to put this card in play.
> Artist: Jim DiBartolo
>
NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: Ratadin
Messages.Body: I would say no, because Set's Curse's ruling follow the "Do X to Y", and thus, if X didn't happen, you cannot resolve Y. In this case, you attempt to burn a ilomba, but instead end up burning a blood. As you did not burn a retainer, you cannot put the Set's Curse in play.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Greetings Meths, been a while!
>
> My question is the following: Can you play Set's Curse on Ilomba?
>
Yes, you can play it (there is a legal target and nothing prohibits it) but as Ratadin pointed out, the following will occur if the action is successful:

- you don't burn Ilomba. Instead, the minion it is attached to burns 1 blood or is burned

EDIT: reverted the following:

- you don't put the Set's Curse into play since Ilomba was not burned, and burning the retainer is the condition to put the Set's Curse into play ("burn... TO ...")

So basically, all it does is burning 1 blood on the minion Ilomba is attached to.
